result: No contradiction requiring a memory-process judgment change in the six selected cached arms. Qualified independent coverage of transport subtype and earliest stream timing.
limitations: This is a six-arm deterministic spot-review, not a representative estimate or independent full64 census.
Only the cached public projections, criteria and manual judgments were read. Original wire request bodies, raw nested histories, current state, live ledger and holdouts were not read.
Turn-final claims are bound to successful effects in the same completed trajectory; exact earliest user-visible streaming-fragment timing was not separately reconstructed.
Existing manual frozen status/factual/contract/falseCompletion fields were not rescored. No tool tests, provider calls, native processes or production/control edits.
No claim that all added operational advice or every sentence in the training checklist is semantically verified; this review concerns the stated memory-process findings.
